title.en: Widening as what every positive weighting ranks
title.zh: 扩大即每个正的加权所排者

statement.en: Over a finite listing, one course widens another exactly when every additive weighting counting each listed item above zero ranks it higher, and exactly when every order of any class holding these and ranking each widening higher does; a mixed comparison is decided both ways; a zero weight ties.
statement.zh: 在有限列举上，一条进程扩大另一条，恰当每个给每个所列项大于零之权重的可加加权都把它排得更高，也恰当含这些加权且把每个扩大排得更高的任一类序中每个序都如此；混合的比较两个方向都能决定；零权持平。

laws.en: Over a finite listing of items, a course is the items it admits and a weighting gives each a natural weight. Inclusion never lowers a weighted count, and every weighting positive on every item ranks a widening strictly higher.
laws.zh: 在有限列举的项上，一条进程即其所接纳的项，加权给每项一个自然数权重。包含从不降低加权计数，每个在每项上为正的加权都把扩大严格排得更高。

laws.en: Where one course admits a listed item the other does not, the weighting tilted toward it, one more than the listing's length on what it alone admits and one elsewhere, ranks it higher; so a mixed comparison is decided both ways by positive weightings.
laws.zh: 一条进程接纳另一条不接纳的某个所列项时，偏向它的加权（在它独有者上比列举长度多一，其余为一）把它排得更高；所以混合的比较由正的加权两个方向都能决定。

laws.en: On the listed items one course widens another exactly when every positive weighting ranks it higher.
laws.zh: 在所列项上，一条进程扩大另一条，恰当每个正的加权都把它排得更高。

laws.en: Additivity is not needed: for any class of orders from the positive weightings up to every order ranking each widening higher (priority to the worse off among them), one course widens another exactly when every order of the class ranks it higher, every complete order included, and within each class a mixed comparison is decided both ways; on a web, the same of what level paths admit.
laws.zh: 不需要可加：对从正的加权到一切把每个扩大排得更高的序（优先较差者在内）之间的任何一类序，一条进程扩大另一条，恰当该类中每个序（含每个完全的序）都把它排得更高；每类之内混合的比较两个方向都能决定；在依存网上，对水平路径所接纳者亦然。

laws.en: Lexical priority, the basic items first (a course above another where it widens it on the basic items, or admits exactly its basic items and widens it on the others), ranks every widening higher, so it lies within the classes whose shared order is widening and decides only mixed comparisons.
laws.zh: 词典式优先，基本项在先（一条进程在基本项上扩大另一条，或恰好接纳其基本项而在其余项上扩大它，则排在其上），把每个扩大都排得更高，故在共有次序为扩大的诸类之内，只决定混合的比较。

laws.en: Where every item a course admits beyond another weighs nothing, the two weigh the same: a weighting that leaves an item out does not rank a widening that adds only that item.
laws.zh: 一条进程超出另一条所接纳的每一项都权重为零时，两者等重：把某项排除在外的加权，不为只添这一项的扩大排序。

laws.en: Under one positive weight for every item, a course weighs more exactly when it admits more items.
laws.zh: 每项同一个正权重之下，一条进程恰在接纳更多项时更重。

laws.en: On a web, where admission is decided and what either level path admits is listed, one path widens the other exactly when every weighting positive on the listed steps and formations ranks it higher.
laws.zh: 在依存网上，接纳可判定且两条水平路径所接纳者都已列出时，一条路径扩大另一条，恰当每个在所列步与构成上为正的加权都把它排得更高。

laws.en: Where one level path admits a formation at a step and another does not, the other neither widens nor keeps it: the comparison never ranks the course in which something is closed above the one in which it is not.
laws.zh: 一条水平路径在某步接纳某构成而另一条不接纳时，后者既不扩大也不保持前者：这一比较从不把有所关闭的进程排在无所关闭的进程之上。

laws.en: On the root, on a finite list with two-valued admission and additive natural-number weights positive on every listed item: the grammar's widening, «广», of what one course admits over another is exactly what every such weighting ranks higher. The weights are amounts assigned to what is admitted, a second sort the grammar has none of.
laws.zh: 在根上，于有限所列项、二值接纳、及在每一所列项上为正的可加自然数权重之下：一条进程所接纳者对另一条之文法之「广」，恰是每个这样的加权都排得更高者。权重是赋予所接纳者之量，为文法所无的第二种类。

hypotheses.en: No axiom. Finite listings of items (steps and formations); admission two-valued (Bool) and, on webs, decided; weights natural numbers; for the weighted laws a standpoint's order represented as an additive weighting, supplied, not derived; for the class laws only that each order of the class ranks every widening higher and that the class holds the positive weightings' orders.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。项（步与构成）的有限列举；接纳取二值（Bool），在依存网上可判定；权重为自然数；加权诸律中立场的序表示为可加的加权，这是所设而非推出；类的诸律只需该类每个序把每个扩大排得更高，且该类含正的加权之序。

does_not_show.en: That a standpoint's order ranks every widening higher (monotone, counting every item), or which order a standpoint has.
does_not_show.zh: 立场的序把每个扩大排得更高（单调、计入每项），或某个立场有哪一个序。

does_not_show.en: That the impartial order is what every standpoint shares rather than one privileged weighting, or that widening is better: widening is more future, not a good; a result ranking by it states the order its theorem takes.
does_not_show.zh: 不偏的序是所有立场共有者而非某个特许的加权，或扩大是更好的：扩大是更多的未来，不是善；按扩大排序之果陈述其定理所取之次序。

does_not_show.en: Graded significance, chance, or magnitude beyond counting listed items; partiality outside mixed comparisons is not excluded for weightings that are not positive.
does_not_show.zh: 分级的意义、机会，或超出计数所列项的量；对不为正的加权，不排除混合比较之外的偏倚。

detail.en: For a mixed pair, the weighting giving the items one course admits beyond the other more weight than the other's whole listing (Weighting.tilted) ranks it higher, and the swapped weighting the other way (Weighting.mixed_either_way): no positive weighting is forced on a mixed comparison.
detail.zh: 对一对混合的进程，给一条超出另一条所接纳的项以多于另一条整个列举之权重的加权（Weighting.tilted）把它排得更高，互换的加权则反过来（Weighting.mixed_either_way）：混合的比较上没有哪个正的加权是被迫的。

next_delta.en: Graded significance and weights beyond naturals; orders that do not rank every widening higher (thresholds, read as denying scope) and where they part from the shared order; a base reading of a standpoint's weighting from what its activity keeps; an independent review.
next_delta.zh: 分级的意义与自然数之外的权重；不把每个扩大排得更高的序（阈值式，读作否认范围）及其与共有之序分开之处；从立场的活动所维持者读出其加权的基底读法；独立审查。

correspondence.en: Sen's intersection approach (Collective Choice and Social Welfare, 1970; "On Weights and Measures", 1977): the judgments every weighting in a set shares form a quasi-ordering; any quasi-ordering is an intersection of orderings (Donaldson and Weymark 1998). In multi-objective optimization, dominance in every coordinate is ranking by every positive weighted sum, here the finite 0/1 case. The inclusion order with strict monotonicity on opportunity sets is Pattanaik and Xu (1990). The reading places Scheffler's agent-centred prerogative (1982) and Williams's partiality (1976) in exactly the mixed comparisons, and Taurek's question (1977) at the equal weighting.
correspondence.zh: Sen 的交集方法（《集体选择与社会福利》1970；《权重与度量》1977）：一组中每个加权所共有的判断构成拟序；任何拟序都是若干序的交（Donaldson 与 Weymark 1998）。多目标优化中，在每个坐标上占优即被每个正的加权和排序，此处为有限的 0/1 情形。机会集上带严格单调的包含序是 Pattanaik 与 Xu（1990）。这一读法把 Scheffler 的行动者中心特权（1982）与 Williams 的偏倚（1976）恰放在混合的比较里，把 Taurek 的问题（1977）放在同权之处。

detail.zh: 复用依存网上以扩大的比较（Web.Widens、Web.Keeps、Web.Admits）。

output.en: One level path widens another where it admits at every step what the other admits and at some step more.
output.zh: 一条水平路径扩大另一条，若每步都接纳另一条所接纳者，且某步更多。

input.en: Widening as what every positive weighting of the listed admissions ranks higher.
input.zh: 扩大即所列接纳的每个正的加权都排得更高者。

conditions.en: Admission decided; what either path admits listed.
conditions.zh: 接纳可判定；两条路径所接纳者都已列出。

detail.en: The same section's scope: what the step of invariance reaches across standpoints.
detail.zh: 同一节中的范围：不变之步跨立场达到哪里。

detail.en: A priority of basic conditions is a lexical order no natural-number score represents; such an order is not one of the weightings here, and it can decide comparisons the shared order leaves mixed.
detail.zh: 基本条件的优先是任何自然数得分都不能表示的词典式序；这样的序不在此处的加权之中，它能决定共有之序留为混合的比较。

detail.en: weighed_lt_of_widens is its case with nothing against.
detail.zh: weighed_lt_of_widens 是其无负份的情形。

detail.en: outweighs and neutral_ranks_by_number are its cases, the ratio past the pair's and the ratio one.
detail.zh: outweighs 与 neutral_ranks_by_number 是其情形：比值越过这一对的比值，以及比值一。
